$comment: Result vocabulary: the registry of obligation types a rule can impose. Every rule's result names one obligation code and supplies its typed params. 'behaviors' lists the engine result types the obligation may use; 'kronto' says what a scheduler should do when the rule fires (block the schedule, compute a premium, or inform). 'compareParam' is the parameter the evaluator uses to pick the most protective rule when several of the same obligation fire; for minimum_required_value obligations 'targetFact' names the scenario fact that is compared against it.

units.hours_pay: Hours of pay at the employee's rate
units.multiplier: Multiple of the regular rate (1.5 = time and a half)
units.hour_of_day: Hour of the day, 0-24, local time

obligations.name: Minimum wage
obligations.description: The lowest hourly rate an employer may pay a covered employee.

params.name: rate
params.description: Minimum hourly rate

obligations.name: Paid sick leave accrual
obligations.description: Sick (or safe) leave the employee accrues per hour worked, with a yearly cap.

params.name: annual_cap_hours
params.description: Hours of leave the employee must be able to accrue (or use) per year

params.name: hours_worked_per_hour_accrued
params.description: Hours worked to accrue one hour of leave (30 means 1 hour per 30 worked)

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave is paid

obligations.name: Family and medical leave entitlement
obligations.description: Weeks of job-protected family or medical leave the employee is entitled to in a benefit year.

params.name: weeks
params.description: Weeks of leave available

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave is paid (state insurance programs) or unpaid (federal FMLA)

obligations.name: Meal break
obligations.description: An uninterrupted meal period owed once a shift reaches a given length.

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Minimum length of the meal period

params.name: after_hours
params.description: Shift length at which the meal period is owed

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the meal period must be paid (usually false)

obligations.name: Rest break
obligations.description: A short paid rest period owed for each block of hours worked.

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Minimum length of each rest period

params.name: per_hours_worked
params.description: One rest period is owed per this many hours worked (or major fraction)

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the rest period is paid (usually true)

obligations.name: Lactation break
obligations.description: Reasonable break time, as often as needed, for an employee to express breast milk, with a private space other than a bathroom.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the break time itself must be paid (false = unpaid unless taken during an existing paid break)

params.name: duration_months
params.description: How long after the child's birth the right lasts, in months (federal: 12); omitted when the law sets no limit

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches, where the law sets one

params.name: hardship_exemption_under
params.description: Employers below this size may claim undue hardship (federal: 50)

params.name: concurrent_with_breaks
params.description: True when the law only guarantees the right to express milk during breaks the employee already has

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Paid minutes per break where the law sets a figure (New York: 30)

obligations.name: Voting leave
obligations.description: Time off to vote on election day when the employee's schedule leaves too little non-working time while polls are open.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the time off must be paid

params.name: hours
params.description: Maximum hours of leave the employee may take; omitted where the law says 'as necessary'

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Advance notice the employer may require, in days (0 = must be requested before election day)

params.name: nonworking_hours_exception
params.description: No leave is owed when the employee has at least this many consecutive non-working hours while polls are open

params.name: employer_sets_time
params.description: Whether the employer may designate when the leave is taken

obligations.name: Jury duty leave
obligations.description: Job-protected leave for jury service; some states require the employer to pay for part of it or bar scheduling the employee around the service day.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the employer must pay regular wages during service (less any jury fee where the law allows)

params.name: paid_days
params.description: Days of service the pay duty covers; omitted when unlimited

params.name: daily_cap_usd
params.description: Cap on the daily pay owed, where the law sets one

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the pay duty attaches

params.name: full_time_only
params.description: Whether only full-time employees are owed pay

params.name: no_work_within_hours
params.description: The employer may not require work within this many hours of the time the employee must report for service

params.name: night_shift_ban
params.description: The employer may not require work between 5 p.m. and 3 a.m. on a day the employee served 4 or more hours

obligations.name: Workweek and workday definition
obligations.description: The fixed, regularly recurring period over which overtime hours are counted; it may start on any day and hour but cannot be moved to avoid overtime.

params.name: period_hours
params.description: Length of the workweek in hours (168 = seven consecutive 24-hour periods)

params.name: workday_hours
params.description: Length of the workday where daily overtime applies (24 consecutive hours)

params.name: fixed_recurring
params.description: The period must be fixed and regularly recurring; changes are allowed only if permanent and not designed to evade overtime

obligations.name: Overtime premium
obligations.description: A multiple of the regular rate owed for hours past a daily or weekly threshold.

params.name: multiplier
params.description: Multiple of the regular rate (1.5, 2)

params.name: threshold_hours
params.description: Hours after which the premium applies

params.name: period
params.description: Whether the threshold is per workday or per workweek

obligations.name: Schedule change premium
obligations.description: Predictability pay owed when the employer changes a posted schedule inside the notice window.

params.name: amount
params.description: Premium amount, in the unit given

params.name: unit
params.description: How the amount is expressed: hours of pay per affected shift, a flat dollar amount, or a percent of the subtracted hours

params.name: notice_window_days
params.description: Changes made with less than this much notice trigger the premium

params.name: change_type
params.description: Which schedule changes trigger the premium: hours added (incl. added shifts), hours reduced (incl. cancellations and early send-home), a time or location change with no change in hours, an on-call shift the employee was not called in for, or any change

obligations.name: Advance schedule notice
obligations.description: The schedule must be posted at least this far ahead of the first shift on it.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Minimum days between posting and the first shift (72 hours = 3)

obligations.name: Rest between shifts (clopening)
obligations.description: A closing shift followed by an opening shift with less than the required rest is barred, or owes a premium, unless the employee consents.

params.name: rest_hours
params.description: Minimum hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next

params.name: amount
params.description: Premium amount, in the unit given

params.name: unit
params.description: How the premium is expressed

obligations.name: Good faith estimate of hours
obligations.description: At hire (and on request or when circumstances change) the employer must give a written good faith estimate of the employee's expected hours, days and shifts.

params.name: lookback_days
params.description: Period the estimate is based on or must be revisited over, where the law sets one (Philadelphia and Chicago: 90 days)

obligations.name: Right to decline late-added hours
obligations.description: The employee may refuse hours or shifts the employer adds or moves inside the notice window; working them needs the employee's consent.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Hours added with less than this much notice may be declined

obligations.name: Offer of hours to existing employees
obligations.description: Before hiring new staff or using a staffing agency to cover hours, the employer must offer those hours to existing (part-time) employees.

params.name: offer_window_hours
params.description: How long the offer must stay open to existing employees before the employer may hire (72 hours = 3 days)

params.name: max_part_time_hours
params.description: Weekly hours below which an employee counts as part-time for the offer, where the law sets one

synonyms: offer of work to existing employees

obligations.name: Late schedule change ban
obligations.description: The employer may not make the named kind of schedule change inside the notice window at all (not merely owe a premium), unless the employee consents in writing where the law allows it.

params.name: notice_hours
params.description: Changes with less than this many hours of notice are barred

params.name: change_type
params.description: Which change is barred

obligations.name: On-call scheduling ban
obligations.description: The employer may not require the employee to be available without scheduling and paying them.

obligations.name: Reporting time pay
obligations.description: Minimum pay owed when an employee reports for a scheduled shift and is sent home early or not put to work.

params.name: minimum_hours
params.description: Minimum hours that must be paid

params.name: maximum_hours
params.description: Cap on the hours owed under the rule

params.name: fraction_of_scheduled
params.description: Fraction of the scheduled shift that must be paid (0.5 = half)

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the hours are paid at

obligations.name: Split shift premium
obligations.description: Extra pay owed when the workday is split by an unpaid, non-meal gap.

params.name: amount
params.description: Hours of pay owed

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the premium is paid at

obligations.name: Spread of hours premium
obligations.description: Extra pay owed when the span from the first to the last hour of the workday exceeds a threshold.

params.name: amount
params.description: Hours of pay owed

params.name: spread_hours
params.description: Workday span that triggers the premium

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the premium is paid at

obligations.name: Weekly day of rest
obligations.description: The employee must get a day (24 consecutive hours) of rest in each week or run of consecutive days.

params.name: max_consecutive_days
params.description: Most consecutive days the employee may be scheduled

params.name: rest_hours
params.description: Consecutive hours of rest owed in each period

params.name: period_days
params.description: Length of the period the rest is owed in (usually 7)

obligations.name: Minor work-hour curfew
obligations.description: Earliest start or latest end time a minor may work, often differing on school nights.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: latest_end_hour
params.description: Work must end by this hour (21 = 9 PM; 24 and above means after midnight)

params.name: earliest_start_hour
params.description: Work may not start before this hour

params.name: school_night
params.description: True when the limit applies only before a school day, false when it applies only outside the school year; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor daily hours limit
obligations.description: Most hours a minor may work in one day.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: max_hours
params.description: Maximum hours in the day

params.name: school_day
params.description: True for school days, false for non-school days; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor weekly hours limit
obligations.description: Most hours a minor may work in one week.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: max_hours
params.description: Maximum hours in the week

params.name: school_week
params.description: True for weeks when school is in session, false for non-school weeks; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor employment restrictions (general)
obligations.description: A state's child labor law summarized as one rule: work permits, hazardous occupations and hour limits not yet split into separate rules.

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

obligations.name: Mass layoff / plant closing notice (WARN)
obligations.description: Advance written notice owed to employees and the state before a plant closing or mass layoff.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Days of advance notice required

params.name: employee_threshold
params.description: Employer size (or affected count) at which the law applies
